arguments.content: Recovery identity must match the operation contract. When audit records persist, locating a recovery record by resource/workspace rather than caller operation ID can make every later operation reuse the first completed record. The API may fabricate success for a fresh ID without applying its values or creating its audit history. Review with two sequential, distinct IDs on one resource, asserting active values, returned identity and separate retained records. Keep operation-ID lookup and completed-ID replay distinct from resource identity. P1 pattern verified in staged save recovery review against base feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67.
